review.claim: Best-known sphere-packing lower bounds found in the documented literature review
review.criterion: Our certified lower bound exceeds the published guarantees and classical consequences compared in the review, and no stronger published lower bound was located.
review.comparison_quantity: Proved lower bound, including theorem guarantees; the actual uncomputed minimum of a prior lattice is not required.
review.comparison_labels: Each numerical comparator states whether it is reported by its source or derived from published inputs.
review.revision_rule: Revise the best-known claim if a stronger prior published bound is identified.
